file_stem: RWB E1 057 Intake from branches mailroom partner SFTP and email
title: Intake from branches, mailroom, partner SFTP and email
goal: Pull branch, mailroom, partner SFTP and mailbox documents into one intake that records the source
why: Paper and e-mail arrive through four channels. One intake step de-duplicates, checks type and size, and hands files to scan, OCR and classification.
ace_note: No ACE read. Intake handles files; case matching happens later (E1-032).

writes.note: source SCAN / PARTNER / EMAIL, channel, hash, size

stores: Branch and mailroom folders; SFTP inbound subfolders per partner_code; Exchange Online mailbox; blob container rwb-intake
rules: BR1: source is SCAN, PARTNER or EMAIL
BR3: the malware scan runs before OCR
BR4: a partner must be ACTIVE
BR6: the source file is moved only after the commit
risks: File type not allowed -> rejected (MSG-P5-001, MSG-P5-007)
Two failed runs on a channel -> alert (MSG-P5-008)
example: scan-0001.pdf (1.2 MB) from branch BR-0123, scanned 2026-11-30 09:12, picked up 09:15
-> document_intake row: source SCAN, channel_code BR-0123, scan_result empty
File LF-007 from partner SFTP -> source PARTNER
